cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You spilled the tea. From now on, pouring needs a permit. I taught you to steady the pot; you can show me that before you get one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who signs it? My bus leaves in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll appoint a pouring supervisor. Good, you're checking who's responsible now. Nobody pours until they've watched your grip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our last supervisor spilled a whole jug himself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then supervisors need a second signature before they pour. Write that down; you've brought me a problem worth adding to the checklist at last.
